properties.description: Reusable metadata-driven ADLS file watcher for one entity/business_dt; checks data file and .SUCCESS marker, updates UC orchestration status, then runs Databricks Bronze + Silver Standardization.

baseParameters.error_message: File or SUCCESS marker not available within max polling limit

message.value: @concat('Databricks Bronze/Silver Standardization failed. Entity=', pipeline().parameters.p_entity_name, ', business_dt=', pipeline().parameters.p_business_dt)

properties.description: Runs one Silver Conformance entity. Routes SCD2 entities to the dedicated customer notebook and all other entities to the generic notebook, while updating layer_processing_status.

message.value: @concat('Silver conformed entity failed. entity_name=', pipeline().parameters.p_entity_name, ', is_scd2=', pipeline().parameters.p_is_scd2)

activities.name: GM_CHECK_LANDING_FOLDER
activities.description: To confirm that the landing folder exists:

activities.name: GM_CHECK_SUCCESS_MARKER
activities.description: To confirm that the marker file exists

message.value:
@if(
    equals(activity('GM_CHECK_SOURCE_FILE').output.exists, false),
    concat(
        'SOURCE FILE MISSING: Source file is not available. ',
        'Entity=', pipeline().parameters.p_entity_name,
        ', BusinessDate=', pipeline().parameters.p_business_dt,
        ', FileName=', pipeline().parameters.p_file_name
    ),
    if(
        equals(activity('GM_CHECK_SUCCESS_MARKER').output.exists, false),
        concat(
            'SUCCESS MARKER MISSING: Success marker file is not available. ',
            'Entity=', pipeline().parameters.p_entity_name,
            ', BusinessDate=', pipeline().parameters.p_business_dt,
            ', ExpectedMarker=', pipeline().parameters.p_file_name, '_SUCCESS'
        ),
        concat(
            'FILE READINESS CHECK FAILED: Unknown readiness issue. ',
            'Entity=', pipeline().parameters.p_entity_name,
            ', BusinessDate=', pipeline().parameters.p_business_dt,
            ', FileName=', pipeline().parameters.p_file_name
        )
    )
)

properties.description: Iterates over active Silver Conformance entities returned from Unity Catalog and invokes PL_03A for each entity with controlled parallelism.

Waits for silver_standardization readiness, initializes silver_conformed status rows, reads entity routing configuration from Unity Catalog, and invokes a child pipeline to process entities in parallel.

value.value: @concat('Silver conformance skipped. silver_standardization was not READY within max wait time. business_dt=', pipeline().parameters.p_business_dt, ', last_status=', variables('v_overall_status'), ', waited_minutes=', variables('v_elapsed_minutes'))

@concat('Silver conformance completed for business_dt=', pipeline().parameters.p_business_dt, '. Entity count=', string(json(activity('NB_GET_SILVER_CONFORMANCE_ENTITIES').output.runOutput).entity_count))
